items.title: السيسي يحسم الجدل: لن أسمح بالمساس بالدستور حتى نهاية ولايتي 2030

items.title: Melbourne Cup champion Half Yours goes down hard in late Caulfield Cup fall
items.detail: Half Yours, last year's Melbourne Cup winner, suffered a nasty fall with about 200 metres remaining in the Caulfield Cup, which was won by Kingswood, while jockey Mark Zahra and another rider were taken to hospital for assessment.

items.title: Quentin Tarantino Returns to Graham Norton's Sofa After Over a Decade
items.detail: Director Quentin Tarantino makes his first appearance on The Graham Norton Show in more than 10 years to discuss his new West End farce, The Popinjay Cavalier.

items.title: Nasdaq Plunges 2% in Worst Weekly Performance Since Late June Sell-Off
items.detail: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite dropped 2.1% on Friday, concluding a difficult week with a 4.5% total loss that ended a monthlong winning streak.

items.title: Super El Niño triggers storm surge across Southern United States this winter

items.title: James Talarico defends moderate platform as tight Texas Senate race intensifies

items.title: Trump tells press secretary Katie Zacharia to reconsider role after five days

items.title: Eagles sign QB Joe Milton off Cowboys practice squad with Hurts sidelined
items.detail: The Philadelphia Eagles signed quarterback Joe Milton from the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad after starting QB Jalen Hurts was ruled out for Week 6 due to a superficial blood clot discovered after their London game against Jacksonville.

items.title: إياد العسقلاني يغيب عن مباراة الإياب: بيراميدز يخسر دفاعه أمام المريخ

items.title: Ballina woman scoops $100 million Powerball jackpot with single winning ticket
items.detail: A woman from Ballina, NSW, became Australia's third-biggest lottery winner after matching all seven numbers and the Powerball on Thursday night, crediting the win to a sign from a recently deceased family member.

items.title: القادسية يطارد الصدارة ضد أبها الذي يبحث عن أول فوز في الدوري
